name: brain-wiki
description: A local-first second brain for AI agents: plain Markdown notes that you own, connected by meaningful links.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory shared by all your AI agents
interface.longDescription: brain-wiki keeps one durable memory for every agent you use, as a folder of plain Markdown notes you own. Agents search it before answering, record what they learn in an inbox, and a validated, undoable consolidation step folds that into notes.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about this project?
Harvest my recent sessions into my brain.
